name: oracle_inventory_action_agent
description: ADK-based coordinator for final-stage inventory action planning. It gathers graph, spatial, and external signals, checks policy, and drafts a recommended inventory move that still requires approval.

extensions.description: Provides native inventory-transfer review controls using the A2UI JSON format.

skills.name: inventory-action-coordinator
skills.description: Coordinates the final inventory action stage by gathering evidence and recommending a transfer, expedite, substitute, or hold action.
examples: Show inventory transfers with a minimum stockout risk of 70, limited to 3 recommendations.
Draft an inventory transfer for SKU-500 and render the approval controls as A2UI.

skills.name: recommendInventoryAction
skills.description: Given a product or risk prompt, gather graph, spatial, and external evidence before proposing a draft inventory move and indicating whether approval is required.
examples: Recommend a draft transfer for SKU-500 and provide A2UI approval controls.
